dialogue_texts: Well, look what the maiden dropped. Finders keepers!
Though... this sparkly energy doesn't look like her usual low-level tricks.
That is a localized spatial-inversion charm.
It isn't her magic; someone else placed it to completely isolate the inner grounds.
A thief who recognizes high-grade boundary manipulation... how unusual.
But knowing its nature won't save you from losing your way entirely.
You're the one warping the layout of this place and keeping the sun from rising, aren't you?
Hand over the trick behind it and I might let you off easy.
Hand it over? Bold words for an ordinary humanoid.
Tonight, the very definition of 'forward' and 'backward' is at my whim.
Let's see how straight your lasers fly when your destination shifts behind you!
